correctness.rationale: The exact monomial diagonal formula follows from normalized circle averaging. The finite-center plus two uniform tail estimates prove scaled eigenvalue convergence to the bilateral Mellin profile. Mellin change of variables yields Gamma Fourier coefficients, proving nonconstancy because Gamma has no zeros. Two-sided power bounds give precisely the critical Schatten exponent. At the critical power, periodic harmonic-sum averaging and an O(1) rearrangement sandwich prove convergence of decreasing-order logarithmic means; this justifies every Dixmier trace value. All parameter endpoints alpha>1 and b>1 and the n=0 index are explicitly handled. The included 276 finite tests are supplemental only.

value.rationale: A natural discretely self-similar positive radial measure exhibits persistent oscillations in the precise canonical eigenvalue power-law coefficient; its Gamma Fourier spectrum detects all frequencies, yet the critical Schatten power has a universal uniquely measurable logarithmic trace. This distinguishes coefficient-level discrete scale invariance from trace-level averaging, a structural question not answered by membership tests. It supplies a parameter-complete exact statement for all positive logarithmic base and circle-decay exponent including a simple alpha=2 closed trace constant, rather than a routine computation of one eigenvalue or a known table.
